F_fod_company.name: The Forces of Darkness, LLC.
F_fod_company.text: Actual evil corporate empire operating raids, occupation, imprisonment, tribute, curses, weather control, necromancy, monster labor and an enormous fortress bureaucracy. Maroon banners bear the established angular gold eye insignia: a central vertical pupil within an outlined eye, with short radiating points. This is the same insignia used in the series masthead at the far left, not a new symbol. Worn stone facilities and ordinary office equipment.

F_fod_free_kingdoms.name: Free Peoples and Elven Competitors
F_fod_free_kingdoms.text: Competent and broadly decent elves, humans and other free peoples. Lady Raindew is an established competitor, not a company employee; their architecture and uniforms are distinct.
